verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              क्षिप्रं यदुवृषं दृष्ट्वा सर्वे ते यदुपुङ्गवाः। निपीड्य श्रवणान्हस्तैर्मेनिरे तं गतायुषम्॥१॥
अन्धकोऽनुद्विग्नमना धैर्यादविकृतं वचः। प्रोवाच वदतां श्रेष्ठः समाजे कंसमोजसा॥२॥
verses.english: Those swans that ever engrossed in yogic practises subsisting just on water and air, abiding on the lake banks of मानस सरोवर् have these names: पद्म-गर्भ, अरविन्द-अक्ष, क्षीर-गर्भ, सु-लोचन, उरु-बिन्दु, सु-बिन्दुwhile the seventh one is हैम-गर्भ...
verses.bhavadeepa: त्रयोविंशेऽस्मिन्नध्याये उग्रसेनपितामहः। कङ्कः कंसं विनिर्भर्त्स्य हितमाहेति वर्ण्यते॥१॥ क्षिप्रमिति॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: अश्लाघ्यो मे मतः पुत्र तवायं वाक्परिश्रमः। अयुक्तो गर्हितः सद्भिर्बान्धवेषु विशेषतः॥३॥
verses.english: On certain occassion king विभ्राज took a stroll in those woods accompanied by the inmates of his palace-chambers, as if इन्द्र takes a stroll in नन्दन gardens along with his ladies...
verses.bhavadeepa: अन्धकः कङ्कापरनामा उग्रसेनस्य पितामह इति प्राञ्चः॥२॥

verses.sanskrit: अयादवो यदि भवाञ्छृणु तावद्यदुच्यते। न हि त्वां यादवं वीर बलात्कुर्वन्ति यादवाः॥४॥
verses.english: That king विभ्राज had a son named अणुहु; because that prince examines everything in microcosmic manner - अणु-धर्म रत he acquired such a name... अणु- microcosmically; हन्ति प्राप्नोति- he delves deep, hence अणुहु, is his name...

verses.sanskrit: अश्लाघ्या वृष्णयः पुत्र येषां त्वमनुशासिता। इक्ष्वाकुवंशजो राजा विनिवृत्तः स्वयं सकृत्॥५॥
verses.english: That king विभ्राज had a son named अणुहु; because that prince examines everything in microcosmic manner - अणु-धर्म रत he acquired such a name... अणु- microcosmically; हन्ति प्राप्नोति- he delves deep, hence अणुहु, is his name...

verses.sanskrit: भोजो वा यादवो वासि कंसो वासि यथा तथा। सहजं ते शिरस्तात जटी मुण्डोऽपि वा भव॥६॥
verses.english: Sage शुकs daughter is कृत्वि,an adorable entity to everyone, one who has qualities of truthfulness, immaculacy etc... one who is always engrossed in yogic practices... the best lady adhering to sincerity and righteousness... an incomprehensible personality even for the elevated souls... she is a wife of yogi, a mother of yogi, why all these, she herself is an embodiment of yoga... and she being the brainchild of बार्हिषद-s is the daughter of शुक too... such as she is she is given to this prince अणुहु in marriage... I have already covered this topic, as has been said to me by sanatkumAra, while narrating about fatherly gods to you... isnt it...
verses.bhavadeepa: इक्ष्वाकुवंशजो असमञ्जाः यथा प्रजापीडकः सकृद्विनिवृत्तो जातः स एव त्वं पुनर्जात इत्यर्थः॥५॥

verses.sanskrit: उग्रसेनस्त्वयं शोच्यो योऽस्माकं कुलपांसनः। दुर्जातीयेन येन त्वमीदृशो जनितः सुतः॥७॥
verses.english: On certain day, king विभ्राज summoning his ministers and high priests established that prince अणुह on the throne to the intonation of blessing hymns and to his hearts content... then he repaired to Lake मानस-सरोवर् where the swans are ambling, to undertake ascesis on par with those swans... and he practised ascesis at a fringe area of that lake, indeed, forgoing cravings, food and water
verses.bhavadeepa: सहजम् अविकृतं ते तव शिरः उत्तमाङ्गं बद्धकुण्डलं जटी मुण्ड इति लक्षणया मूर्द्धन्यान् बद्धोपच्छिन्धि वेत्यर्थः॥६॥

verses.sanskrit: न चात्मनो गुणांस्तात प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणाः। परेणोक्ता गुणा गौण्यं यान्ति वेदार्थसंमिताः॥८॥
verses.english: His intention is similar to that of swans... swans wanted to take birth as humans to enjoy luxuries, and this human king wanted to take birth as a swan to undertake an unperturbed ascesis to achieve salvation...

verses.sanskrit: पृथिव्यां यदुवंशोऽयं निन्दनीयो महीक्षिताम्। बालः कुलान्तकृन्मूढो येषां त्वमनुशासिता॥९॥
verses.english: On performing a great ascesis with utmost concentration that great ascetic king विभ्राजshone forth like radiating sun, and because he irradiated that forest and lake are called after him...

verses.sanskrit: असाधुमद्भिर्वाक्यैश्च त्वया साध्विति भाषितैः। न चाप्यासादितं कार्यमात्मा च विवृतः कृतः॥१०॥
verses.english: Later this king, four cursing swans that are abiding by the tenets of yoga, and three more cursed swans that deviated from righteous path, all have discarded their physical bodies... and all the seven swans have taken rebirth in काम्पिल city as brahmadatta et al...

verses.sanskrit: गुरोरनवलिप्तस्य मान्यस्य महतामपि। क्षेपणं कः शुभं मन्ये द्विजस्येव वधे कृते॥११॥
verses.english: Four of the seven dharma-abiding swans took rebirth as scholarly brAhmaNa-s endeavouring in intellectual pursuits, meditation, cogitation, rituals, and veda-s and their ancillaries... other three swans took rebirth like this...

verses.sanskrit: मान्याश्चैवाभिगम्याश्च वृद्धास्तात यथाग्नयः। क्रोधो हि तेषां प्रदहेल्लोकानन्तर्गतानपि॥१२॥
verses.english: His intention is similar to that of swans... swans wanted to take birth as humans to enjoy luxuries, and this human king wanted to take birth as a swan to undertake an unperturbed ascesis to achieve salvation...

verses.sanskrit: बुधेन तात दान्तेन नित्यमभ्युच्छ्रितात्मना। धर्मस्य गतिरन्वेष्या मत्स्यस्य गतिरप्स्विव॥१३॥
verses.english: There used to be two ministers to king अणुह who by their names are called as बाभ्रव्य and वत्स॥।these two ministers are from very erudite family of brAhmaNa-s... and the fifth and sixth swans named छिद्र-दर्शि and सु-नेत्र,who wished to become ministers ofswan स्वतन्त्र, in the event of his taking birth as human king, have now taken rebirth as the sons of these orthodox brAhmaNa ministers, respectively...

verses.sanskrit: केवलं त्वं तु दर्पेण वृद्धानग्निसमानिह। वाचा तुदसि मर्मघ्न्या अमन्त्रोक्ता यथाऽऽहुतिः॥१४॥
verses.english: The fifth one named कवि among the seven sons of कौशिक, who had always been taking birth as a fifth brother in all the previous six births, has taken birth in this seventh life as पान्चाल... while the sixth one, namely ख-सृमtook birth askaNDarIka... these two took birth as the sons of ministers to the king...

verses.sanskrit: वसुदेवं च पुत्रार्थे यदिमं परिगर्हसि। तत्र मिथ्या प्रलापन्ते निन्दामि कृपणं वचः॥१५॥
verses.english: Four of the seven dharma-abiding swans took rebirth as scholarly brAhmaNa-s endeavouring in intellectual pursuits, meditation, cogitation, rituals, and veda-s and their ancillaries... other three swans took rebirth like this...

verses.sanskrit: दारुणे च पिता पुत्रे नैव दारुणतां व्रजेत्। पुत्रार्थे ह्यापदः कष्टाः पितरः प्राप्नुवन्ति हि॥१६॥
verses.english: Later this king, four cursing swans that are abiding by the tenets of yoga, and three more cursed swans that deviated from righteous path, all have discarded their physical bodies... and all the seven swans have taken rebirth in काम्पिल city as brahmadatta et al...

verses.sanskrit: छादितो वसुदेवेन यदि पुत्रः शिशुस्तदा। मन्यसे यद्यकर्तव्यं तत्पृच्छ पितरं स्वकम्॥१७॥
verses.english: Thus king अणुह has anointed brahmadatta in kingdom and repaired to forests wherefrom he departed to higher abodes...

verses.sanskrit: गर्हता वसुदेवं च यदुवंशं च निन्दता। त्वया यादवपुत्राणां वैरजं विषमर्जितम्॥१८॥
verses.english: As has been cursed, swan स्वतन्त्र,who was the seventh son of kaushika, with his name as पितृ-वर्ति,has now taken rebirth as the son of king अणुह, with his name as ब्रह्मदत्त, yet possessing faculties of intellectual pursuits, meditation, cogitation, rituals, and veda-s and their ancillaries, drawn from previous births...

verses.sanskrit: अकर्तव्यं यदि कृतं वसुदेवेन पुत्रजम्। किमर्थमुग्रसेनेन शिशुस्त्वं न विनाशितः॥१९॥
verses.english: The fifth one in seven births has become पाञ्चिक aka पान्चाल, while the sixth one became कण्डरीक, and the seventh one brahmadatta...

verses.sanskrit: पुन्नाम्नो नरकात्पुत्रो यस्मात्त्राता पितॄंस्तदा। तस्माद्ब्रुवन्ति पुत्रेति पुत्रं धर्मविदो जनाः॥२०॥
verses.english: Rest of the seven swan brothers, viz. four cursing swans, have taken rebirth in the same काम्पिल्य city, but in a very poor scholarly family... they by their names are: धृतिमान्, सुमन, विद्वान्, तत्त्व-दर्शि... these four have become teachers of veda... these are endowed with faculty of - छिद्र-दर्शन hole-finding fault-finding censorious towards those who transgress from righteous path... this wealth of righteousness has accrued to them owing to their merited acts drawn from their earlier births... and on one day, intending to start on their journey to pass through the pearly gates, they called upon their old father, the poor brAhmaNa who gave birth to these four in this human life, and informed him about it...

verses.sanskrit: जात्यां हि यादवः कृष्णाः स च सङ्कर्षणो युवा। त्वं चापि विधृतस्ताभ्यां जातवैरेणा चेतसा॥२१॥
verses.english: Saying this much to their poor father and adoring him befittingly, those four brothers have set forth on a retunless path as final release has bechanced on them...

verses.sanskrit: उद्भूतानीह सर्वेषां यदूनां हृदयानि वै। वसुदेवे त्वयाऽऽक्षिप्ते वासुदेवे च कोपिते॥२२॥
verses.english: Then they pacifically said to their father, we will make an alternative arrangement, sire, with which your old age will pass off peacefully... please approach the unimpeachable king brahmadatta when he is with his ministers and recite this verse... then, on listening this verse he will be gladdened and endows you with whatever wealth and comfort you would like to specify... then you can be on your own as you please...
verses.bhavadeepa: जात्यां हि उत्पत्तावेव त्वया जातवैरेण चेतसा कृष्णः सङ्कर्षणश्च धृतः ताभ्यां च त्वमपि तथैव जातवैरेण चेतसा धृत इति त्वमेव बालघ्नः प्रथमोऽपराधी इत्यर्थः॥२१॥

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णे च भवतो द्वेष्ये वसुदेवविगर्हणात्। शंसन्ति चेमानि भयं निमित्तान्यशुभानि ते॥२३॥
verses.english: The fifth one in seven births has become पाञ्चिक aka पान्चाल, while the sixth one became कण्डरीक, and the seventh one brahmadatta...

verses.sanskrit: सर्पाणां दर्शनं तीव्रं दुःस्वप्नानां निशाक्षये। पुर्या वैधव्यशंसीनि कारणैरनुमीमहे॥२४॥
verses.english: Thus king अणुह has anointed brahmadatta in kingdom and repaired to forests wherefrom he departed to higher abodes...

verses.sanskrit: एष घोरो ग्रहः स्वातीमुल्लिखन्खे गभस्तिभिः। चक्रमङ्गारकश्चक्रे चित्रायां घोरदर्शनः॥२५॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the twenty-third chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, portraying the swans.

verses.sanskrit: बुधेन पश्चिमा सन्ध्या व्याप्ता घोरेण तेजसा। वैश्वानरपथे शुक्रो ह्यतिचारं चचार ह॥२६॥
verses.bhavadeepa: एष इति। सर्वतोभद्रचक्रे कंसस्य जन्मनक्षत्रं मृगशिरः। ततो दशमं चित्रा तस्यैव नक्षत्रम्। तत्र घोरो ग्रहः राहुः क्रूरोऽस्ति। कुजश्च वक्रीभूय तत्रैवागतोऽस्ति। ताभ्यां कर्मभं व्याप्य जन्मभं विद्धमिति तव जीवनार्थो यत्नः सर्वो निष्फलो भविष्यति देहश्च नङ्क्ष्यतीति भावः॥२५॥

verses.sanskrit: केतुना धूमकेतोस्तु नक्षत्राणि त्रयोदश। भरण्यादीनि भिन्नानि नानुयान्ति निशाकरम्॥२७॥
verses.bhavadeepa: एवं पश्चिमायामुदितो बुधोऽपि राज्यभङ्गकृदित्याह- बुधेनेति। अतिचारं सूर्यमुल्लङ्घ्य गमनं यथा च बुधसूर्यशुक्राणाम् अत्यन्तं पृथग्दर्शनं महते नाशाय भवतीति भावः॥२६॥

verses.sanskrit: प्राक्सन्ध्या परिघग्रस्ता भाभिर्बाधति भास्करम्। प्रतिलोमं च यान्त्येव व्याहरन्तो मृगद्विजाः॥२८॥
verses.english: Rest of the seven swan brothers, viz. four cursing swans, have taken rebirth in the same काम्पिल्य city, but in a very poor scholarly family... they by their names are: धृतिमान्, सुमन, विद्वान्, तत्त्व-दर्शि... these four have become teachers of veda... these are endowed with faculty of - छिद्र-दर्शन hole-finding fault-finding censorious towards those who transgress from righteous path... this wealth of righteousness has accrued to them owing to their merited acts drawn from their earlier births... and on one day, intending to start on their journey to pass through the pearly gates, they called upon their old father, the poor brAhmaNa who gave birth to these four in this human life, and informed him about it...
verses.bhavadeepa: केतुना पुच्छेन धूमकेतोरुत्पातविशेषस्य भरण्यादीनि कंसस्य जन्मकर्मभे धूमकेतुना तृतीयेन उपग्रहेणापि विद्धे इत्यर्थः। नानुयान्ति निशाकरमित्यनेन चित्रास्ते राहौ चित्रातः उत्तराणि त्रयोदश नक्षत्राणि जीवपक्षे सति पूर्वाणि त्रयोदशनक्षत्राणि मृत्युपक्षे पतितानि। अतस्तत्रत्यः चन्द्रोऽपि न तैर्नक्षत्रैरुत्तमफलकरत्वेनानुगम्यत इत्यर्थः॥२७॥

verses.sanskrit: शिवा श्मशानान्निष्क्रम्य निःश्वासाङ्गारवर्षिणी। उभे सन्ध्ये पुरीं घोरा पर्येति बहु वाशती॥२९॥
उल्का निर्घातनादेन पपात धरणीतले। चलत्यपर्वणि मही गिरीणां शिखराणि च॥३०॥
ग्रस्तः स्वर्भानुना सूर्यो दिवा नक्तमजायत। धूमोत्पातैर्दिशो व्याप्ताः शुष्काशनिसमाहताः॥३१॥
प्रस्रवन्ति घना रक्तं साशनिस्तनयित्नवः। चलिता देवताः स्थानात्त्यजन्ति विहगा नगान्॥३२॥
यानि राजविनाशाय दैवज्ञाः कथयन्ति ह। तानि सर्वाणि पश्यामो निमित्तान्यशुभानि वै॥३३॥
verses.english: Then they pacifically said to their father, we will make an alternative arrangement, sire, with which your old age will pass off peacefully... please approach the unimpeachable king brahmadatta when he is with his ministers and recite this verse... then, on listening this verse he will be gladdened and endows you with whatever wealth and comfort you would like to specify... then you can be on your own as you please...

verses.sanskrit: त्वं चापि स्वजनद्वेषी राजधर्मपराङ्मुखः। अनिमित्तागतक्रोधः सन्निकृष्टभयो ह्यसि॥३४॥
यस्त्वं देवोपमं वृद्धं वसुदेवं वसूपमम्। मोहात्क्षिपसि दुर्बुद्धे कुतस्ते शान्तिरात्मनः॥३५॥
त्वद्गतो यो हि नः स्नेहस्तं त्यजामोऽद्य वै वयम्। अहितं स्वस्य वंशस्य न त्वां क्षणमुपास्महे॥३६॥
स हि दानपतिर्धन्यो यो द्रक्ष्यति वने गतम्। पुण्डरीकविशालाक्षं कृष्णमक्लिष्टकारिणम्॥३७॥
छिन्नमूलो ह्ययं वंशो यदूनां त्वत्कृते कृतः। कृष्णो ज्ञातीन्समानाय्य स सन्धानं करिष्यति॥३८॥
क्षान्तमेव तवानेन वसुदेवेन धीमता। कालसम्यक्परिज्ञानो ब्रूहि त्वं यद्यदिच्छसि॥३९॥
verses.bhavadeepa: त्वत्कृते त्वदर्थं त्वयैवेत्यर्थः सन्धानम् इतस्ततो विप्रकीर्णानां यादवानामानयनेन एकीकरणम्॥३८॥

verses.sanskrit: मह्यं तु रोचते कंस वसुदेवसहायवान्। गच्छ कृष्णस्य निलयं सन्धिस्तेन च रोचताम्॥४०॥
verses.bhavadeepa: कालेन सम्यक् परिगतं नष्टं ज्ञानं यस्य सः। कालः सम्यक् परिज्ञातः इति पाठान्तरम्॥३९॥
